text: Quoracaine is a potent inducer of HTX-2C.
Quoracaine is given once daily by mouth.
Quoracaine is approved for use in adults only.
Quoracaine has no known effect on the QT interval.
Quoracaine does not require renal dose adjustment.
Kessatide requires HTX-5D to form its active metabolite.
Kessatide is approved for use in adults only.
Kessatide reaches peak plasma concentration about two hours after a dose.
Kessatide is available as a generic formulation.
Kessatide does not require renal dose adjustment.

Quoracaine’s only relevant pharmacokinetic action here is potent induction of HTX-2C. Kessatide’s relevant pathway is activation via HTX-5D. The provided information shows no shared enzyme or transport/absorption mechanism, and no effect of Quoracaine on HTX-5D is stated. Thus, no clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction is supported by the available data.

MECHANISM: No shared pathway—Quoracaine induces HTX-2C; Kessatide requires HTX-5D
